question.text: Under the Stewardship Code released by SEBI (Circular Nos. CIR/CFD/CMD 1/168/19 dated December 24, 2019 and CFD/CMD1/CIR/P/2020/55 dated March 30, 2020), all AIFs are required to do which of the following in relation to their listed equity securities/listed investments?

answer.text: Maintain a 10% minimum voting stake in every listed investee company
Publish every vote cast within 24 hours on the AIF's website
Actively monitor investee companies and vote in important company matters, and have a clear policy for collaboration with other institutional investors
Route all proxy votes through a SEBI-empanelled voting agent

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Ch 11.2.4.1 and Ch 11.7.1, under SEBI's Stewardship framework for AIF investments in listed equity securities/listed investments, all AIFs are required to actively monitor their investee companies and vote in important company matters. They must have a clear policy for intervention and collaboration with other institutional investors to preserve ultimate investors' interests, and a voting/disclosure policy. The Trap: There is no 10% minimum voting-stake mandate in the source. Daily public vote disclosure within 24 hours is not required. There is no SEBI-empanelled voting-agent mandate. Note: The Stewardship Code obligations apply in relation to listed equity securities/listed investments, not unlisted holdings, per the source framing.
